title: Chunk transparency
requirement: WHEN proof production inserts a technical chunk boundary, that boundary SHALL preserve source-visible execution observations.
expectedSource: spec text only; no expectation was derived from implementation behavior

scenarios.name: Boundary before return
scenarios.when: A pure run is chunked between callee return and caller addition.
scenarios.then: It retains the same result, frame sequence, effects, duties and cumulative logical work, without introducing a financial commit.
scenarios.blocker: needs a chunked-execution entrypoint with a boundary between callee return and caller addition
